scope: Proposition 5.1 of the manuscript “Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields” (preprints/Modularity-of-elliptic-curves-over-imaginary-quadratic-fields-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 030 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c74cc37755f500be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every t ∈ U(K) and every rotation character θ, the representations Vθ,ℓ have the following properties. 1. They are semisimple of dimension two, with determinant ϵ−1 ℓ . 2. At every place of F above ℓ, they are potentially semistable with labelled Hodge–Tate weights {0, 1}. 3. There is a finite set of places S of F, independent of ℓ, such that Vθ,ℓ is unramified at every v / ∈ S of residue characteristic different from ℓ. At such a place its Frobenius characteristic polynomial is the image under jℓ of a polynomial in M[T] independent of ℓ.
